headline: Top three container shipping firms: July revenue up 30–50% year on year, optimistic momentum in peak season will continue | Securities
summary: The three major container shipping firms reported July revenue up 30% to 50% year on year, helped by demand and geopolitics lifting freight rates. The industry expects peak-season momentum to continue.
why: Container shipping lines carry most of the world's manufactured goods, so freight rates and volumes influence global trade costs and shipping equities.
